integrity: Full proofs supplied; tests use exact integers; self-review only, no independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed coefficient 3 and ordered (a,b). The numerical recurrence itself already appears in OEIS A007052, but no inspected source gives its Moser+3Moser interpretation and sharp Fibonacci maximal multiplicity. Full Eigen–Ito–Prasad text was not accessible. Moser's 1962 original has only issue/year precision; 2001-02-07 is the earliest examined day-specific public source comment, not a fabricated publication day for older work. Finite regressions are not proofs and unindexed prior coverage remains possible.
title: A spectral counting law and Fibonacci multiplicities for the Moser–de Bruijn coefficient-three sumset
